      title: Owner fields

          type: string

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin

          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'

          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.

          type: string
          minLength: 1

          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
